g.text: Validate device id, laptop, positive target, max 20 watches per device
Upsert watch (new target starts a new alert episode)
Latest offer per retailer with observedAt
Take lowest comparable offer; check age against 48 h limit
[fresh offer at or below target and no alert in this episode]
Set alerted and store alert with deduplication key (one transaction)
[fresh offer above target after an earlier alert]
